faq.a: Standard watch links, youtu.be short links, Shorts, Live and embed URLs. A bare 11-character video ID also works.

faq.q: Why is my image smaller than 1280x720?
faq.a: YouTube only stores a max-resolution thumbnail when the uploader set one. The tool always shows the largest supported size available for the video.

faq.q: Can I download a thumbnail on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. The tool works in mobile browsers. If your browser blocks the download, use Copy image URL or Open image and save it from the new tab.

faq.q: Can I reuse a downloaded thumbnail?
faq.a: Only if you own the video or have permission from the rights holder. Downloading does not grant reuse rights, and ReelFlow is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
